input.name: can-edit
input.covers: canEdit() is the doc.pages.assemble authority, wildcard included; it is the one twin for every structure verb.

input.name: rotate-by
input.covers: rotateBy turns a relative turn into the absolute wire from the registry rotation, wrapping into [0, 360); an unknown page rejects not-found; any number is carried through the arithmetic.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: rotate-by-follows-the-registry
input.covers: After a pages.rotated event replaces the registry, rotateBy starts from the new rotation.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: passthroughs
input.covers: setRotation, move and delete forward their arguments unchanged and return the engine promise, which settles with the engine answer.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: a document keeps at least one page

input.name: refused-by-the-engine
input.covers: Without doc.pages.assemble canEdit() is false, and every verb still calls the engine, whose PermissionDenied rejects the returned promise with its full shape.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: deferred-and-aborted
input.covers: A deferred edit settles when the engine answers, and the verbs run one at a time: the delete reaches the engine only after the rotate settles.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: add-blank
input.covers: insertBlank: append by default sized like the last page; ref placements land after/before the anchor sized like it; an index placement is forwarded verbatim and sized like its predecessor, clamped into the registry; explicit size and count win; a missing anchor rejects not-found.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: add-blank-fractional-index
input.covers: An index placement that is not an integer (or NaN) makes the predecessor lookup read a page that does not exist, which throws the TypeError the TypeScript throws; an explicit size skips the lookup.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: insert
input.covers: insertFromBytes forwards the bytes and the resolved placement index; a missing anchor rejects not-found before any engine call.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: a-captured-capability-outlives-its-document
input.covers: A capability captured before its document closed keeps its guarded handle and the last registry it saw: canEdit still answers, and each verb still reaches the engine, but its promise rejects instance-closed (the kernel no longer resolves the capability).
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: an-empty-registry
input.covers: A document with no pages: rotation reads as 0, a PON anchor is not found, and a blank page defaults to US Letter wherever it goes.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

$error.message: page undefined is not in this document

input.name: rotate-by-groups-and-empty
input.covers: rotateBy groups pages by their resulting rotation and makes one engine call per group, in first-seen order, resolving with the last answer; no pages rejects invalid-input without an engine call.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: move-to-the-end
input.covers: move with 'end' (or no placement) sends the registry's page count as the destination; ref placements resolve after or before their anchor.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: insert-a-subset-of-another-pdf
input.covers: insertFromBytes with pageIndexes opens the bytes beside the document (full scope, an id from the clock), lists its pages, extracts the chosen ones by ref, inserts the extract at the placement and closes the source. A missing index rejects not-found and still closes the source; a refused open rejects with the mapped error.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: insert-a-subset-names-the-missing-index
input.covers: The source id is Date.now() in base 36. A pageIndexes entry that is negative, fractional or not finite names no page and rejects not-found, the message spelling the index as String() does (1e+21, 1e-7 and all).
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: rotate-by-a-page-without-a-rotation
input.covers: A registry page with no rotation turns into NaN, which is its own Map key: the numbered pages still group apart from it, one engine call per group.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: insert-from-another-document
input.covers: insertFromDocument extracts the pages from the other open document's handle and inserts the bytes at the placement ('end' by default); a document that is not open rejects not-found; a refused extract rejects with the mapped error.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

input.name: duplicate
input.covers: duplicate extracts the pages and inserts the copy right after the last of them by default, or at the placement given; no pages rejects invalid-input before any engine call.
input.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.
